requirements.statement: The system displays a list of products with name, thumbnail image, price, and stock status.

criteria.must: The product list shows each product's name
The product list shows each product's thumbnail image
The product list shows each product's price
The product list shows each product's stock status (in stock / out of stock)

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view a product detail page with full description, images, price, and available variants.

criteria.must: The product detail page shows the full description
The product detail page shows product images
The product detail page shows the price
The product detail page shows the available variants (e.g. size, glaze color)

requirements.statement: Each product variant has its own price (or price delta) and inventory count.

criteria.must: Selecting a different variant reflects that variant's own price
Each variant tracks its own inventory count independent of other variants

requirements.statement: The system prevents adding an out-of-stock variant to the cart and clearly indicates out-of-stock variants.

criteria.must: An out-of-stock variant is visually indicated as unavailable on the product page
Attempting to add an out-of-stock variant to the cart is blocked

requirements.statement: Shoppers can search products by name/keyword and filter by category and/or attribute.

criteria.must: Searching by a keyword returns matching products by name
Filtering by category narrows the product list to that category
Filtering by an attribute (e.g. color) narrows the product list accordingly

requirements.statement: The system supports browsing products by category.

criteria.must: Selecting a category shows only products in that category

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add a specific product variant and quantity to a cart.

criteria.must: Adding a variant with a chosen quantity places that exact variant and quantity in the cart

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view, update quantities in, and remove items from the cart.

criteria.must: The cart view lists all added items
Updating a line item's quantity changes the quantity stored in the cart
Removing a line item deletes it from the cart

requirements.statement: The system recomputes the cart subtotal whenever cart contents change.

criteria.must: The displayed subtotal updates immediately after a quantity change, addition, or removal

requirements.statement: The cart persists for the duration of a guest's browsing session and across sessions/devices for a signed-in customer.

criteria.must: A guest's cart survives navigating between pages within the same browsing session
A signed-in customer's cart is available after signing in again on a different session

requirements.statement: The system re-validates item availability when proceeding from cart to checkout and flags items that went out of stock.

criteria.must: Proceeding to checkout triggers a stock re-check of every cart line item
An item that became out of stock since being added is flagged to the shopper at checkout

requirements.statement: A visitor can create an account with an email and password (or equivalent credential).

criteria.must: A visitor can submit an account registration with an email and password and the account is created

requirements.statement: A registered customer can log in and log out.

criteria.must: A registered customer can log in with valid credentials and reach an authenticated state
A logged-in customer can log out and return to an unauthenticated state

requirements.statement: A registered customer can save one or more shipping addresses for reuse at checkout.

criteria.must: A registered customer can save a shipping address to their account
A saved address can be selected for reuse during checkout
A registered customer can save more than one address

requirements.statement: A registered customer can view their past orders and each order's status and contents.

criteria.must: The order history lists the customer's past orders
Each listed order shows its current status
Each listed order can be opened to show its line-item contents

requirements.statement: A shopper without an account can complete checkout as a guest, supplying shipping and contact details for that order only.

criteria.must: A shopper can complete checkout and place an order without signing in or creating an account

requirements.statement: The system offers a guest, at or after checkout, the option to create an account using the details just entered.

criteria.must: At or after guest checkout, the shopper is offered an option to create an account

requirements.statement: The system collects a shipping address and contact email during checkout for both guest and registered customers.

criteria.must: Checkout requires a shipping address before payment can proceed
Checkout requires a contact email before payment can proceed

requirements.statement: The system applies a single flat-rate shipping fee to every order regardless of destination or order size.

criteria.must: The same shipping fee is applied to orders with different destinations
The same shipping fee is applied to orders with different item counts/subtotals

requirements.statement: The system displays an order summary with line items, subtotal, shipping fee, and total before payment is submitted.

criteria.must: The pre-payment order summary lists each line item
The pre-payment order summary shows the subtotal, shipping fee, and total

requirements.statement: The system captures card payment through a third-party payment gateway and does not itself store raw card numbers.

criteria.must: Card payment is completed via the third-party payment gateway's flow
The system's own data store never contains a raw card number

requirements.statement: The system creates an order only after the payment gateway confirms successful payment.

criteria.must: No order is created when the payment gateway reports a failed or declined payment
An order is created after the payment gateway confirms successful payment

requirements.statement: The system performs a final inventory check at order placement and rejects/rolls back the order if any item is no longer available.

criteria.must: An order placement attempt for an item that became unavailable just before placement is rejected or rolled back
A rejected/rolled-back order does not retain a successful charge without remedy

requirements.statement: On successful payment, the system decrements inventory for each purchased variant and presents an order confirmation to the shopper.

criteria.must: After a successful order, the purchased variant's stock count is decremented by the purchased quantity
The shopper sees an order confirmation immediately after successful payment

requirements.statement: The system notifies the customer of their order confirmation, including an order reference number.

criteria.must: The customer receives an order confirmation notification (e.g. email) after a successful order
The confirmation includes an order reference number

requirements.statement: Every order has a status visible to the customer who placed it.

criteria.must: The customer who placed an order can view its current status

requirements.statement: A guest may look up an order's status using the order reference and the email address used at checkout.

criteria.must: Supplying the correct order reference and checkout email returns that order's status and contents
Supplying an incorrect reference/email combination does not return another customer's order
